## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Madrid, Spain. It starts at Museo Nacional del Prado, Calle de Ruiz de Alarcón, 23, Madrid. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to the Prado Museum.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Visit the Prado Museum, a true paradise for art lovers and a must-visit cultural landmark in Madrid. This entrance ticket grants you access to one of the world's most renowned art collections, allowing you to embark on a mesmerizing journey through centuries of artistic masterpieces.
>
> The Prado Museum is housed in an elegant neoclassical building, a work of art in itself, which sets the stage for the treasures that await within its walls. The museum boasts an extraordinary collection of over 8,000 paintings and countless other artistic treasures, representing various periods and styles from the Middle Ages to the 19th century.
>
> Discover the genius of artists such as Velázquez, Goya, El Greco, and Titian as their works come to life before your eyes. Allow yourself to be transported through time as you explore the evolution of artistic expression.
>
> Admire the delicate details of religious art, the grandeur of royal portraits, and the stirring narratives depicted in historical and mythological scenes. Every turn reveals a new masterpiece, inviting you to delve deeper into the world of art.
